title: A Border Strategy Analysis of Ad Source and Message Tone in Senatorial Campaigns
authors: Yanwen Wang; Michael V. Lewis; David A. Schweidel
eligible_reason: Border-discontinuity design with continuous treatments: log GRP ratios of candidate and PAC positive/negative ads by county-year (2010, 2012), estimated as a SUR system with county FE and border-by-year FE. No binary staggered treatment. Data are NDA-covered and replaced by synthetic data.
design_notes: simulatedata.R: lm(logvsratio ~ logratio_hhgrpcanneg + logratio_hhgrpcanpos + logratio_hhgrppacneg + logratio_hhgrppacpos + as.factor(countyidnew) + as.factor(borderidnew):I(yeardummy)); same for logturnoutratio with log totals; GLS/SUR across the two equations.
data_files_note: Code comment: 'The data is NDA-covered. Synthetic data are provided to closely replicate the results.'
software_notes: Base R lm plus matrix SUR.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; abstract and package read.
